text: Manufacturing activity in the sample expanded for the third consecutive month, with the expansion rate accelerating slightly from the previous reading. New export orders rose and supplier delivery times shortened.
The central bank held the policy rate steady, stating that inflation remains above target but that the disinflation trend continues. Two members voted for a quarter-point cut.
Consumer confidence rose to a fourteen-month high, driven by stronger labour market data and easing food price inflation. Retailers reported a measurable pickup in discretionary spending.
Energy prices fell sharply on increased supply and mild weather. Utilities said lower wholesale costs will be passed through to end users from the next billing cycle.

The regulator published consultation responses on cross-border data transfers, indicating that the final rules will permit the vast majority of existing transfer mechanisms to continue without additional approval.
Housing transaction volumes in the metro area declined for a fourth month. Inventory of unsold units rose, and two large developers announced discounts to clear stock.
A major automaker confirmed it will move production of two models to a new plant, adding an estimated eight hundred direct jobs over eighteen months.
Analysts tracking the semiconductor cycle noted inventory normalisation is complete at foundries, though capital expenditure guidance remains flat rather than expanding.
The opposition filed a formal request for a public inquiry into procurement practices. The government described the request as procedurally valid but declined to commit to a timeline.
Unemployment claims fell for the fourth week in a row, with continuing claims also declining, suggesting re-employment rather than withdrawal from the labour force.
A long-running trade dispute was resolved through arbitration, with both parties withdrawing the retaliatory tariffs announced earlier in the year.
The sports federation selection committee delayed the decision on the head coach appointment pending a governance review of the selection process.
